decisions.reason: Premium support directly embodies the firm's announced agency-focused, round-the-clock expert service strategy, so it stays even though it no longer appears visibly on the website.

The in-house development invested in the version management tool and its integration into the established hosting platform favor keeping it, though its disappearance from the website suggests it may have been folded into other offers.
The tool is distant from the core business and the GDPR demand peak has passed, but its multi-model build and the low cost of keeping it running favor persistence for now.
Scalable agency hosting is the publicly announced flagship of the firm's direction and is closest to its core, so commitment to it is strongest.
